title: Cause, effect and purpose in formal register
objectives: Express cause formally with dahil sa, sanhi ng, dulot ng and bunga ng
State purpose with upang and para (na), choosing the right register
Master the nang vs ng spelling rule in all its uses
Read and produce cause-and-effect prose of the kind found in reports and news

grammar.title: The formal causes: sanhi ng, dulot ng, bunga ng
grammar.explanation:
Dahil sa 'because of' you know well. Formal writing adds three near-synonyms built on nouns: sanhi 'cause', dulot 'effect brought', and bunga 'fruit/result'. As phrases: sanhi ng 'caused by / the cause being', dulot ng 'brought about by', bunga ng 'as a result of'. News style: Nagbaha sa lungsod dulot ng walang tigil na ulan — 'The city flooded due to nonstop rain.' Nasira ang mga pananim bunga ng tagtuyot — 'The crops were destroyed as a result of the drought.'

They also work as nouns: Ano ang sanhi ng sunog? — 'What was the cause of the fire?' Malaki ang pinsalang dulot nito — 'The damage it brought is great.' Bunga nito, ... as a sentence opener means 'As a result, ...'.

Register map: dahil sa (neutral, safe everywhere), dulot ng and sanhi ng (news, reports), bunga ng (formal, slightly literary). In speech, kasi still rules: Na-late ako kasi ma-traffic. You now command the full range from kasi to bunga ng — choose by context.

grammar.title: Purpose: upang and para (na)
grammar.explanation:
Both upang and para introduce purpose clauses: Nag-ipon siya upang makabili ng lupa / Nag-ipon siya para makabili ng lupa — 'He saved up in order to buy land.' Upang is the formal, written choice; para the everyday one. After upang/para the verb is typically in its infinitive (unconjugated) form when the actor is the same, or takes a full clause when it changes: Nagmadali ako para hindi tayo ma-late — 'I hurried so that we wouldn't be late.'

With a different actor, para often becomes para + linked pronoun: para makapag-aral ang mga anak niya 'so that his children could study'. Purpose with a noun uses para sa: para sa kinabukasan 'for the future'; recall benefactive i- verbs cover 'doing something FOR someone' (ibinili kita ng pagkain), so Tagalog often prefers a benefactive verb where English says 'for'.

Negative purpose is upang hindi / para hindi (formal: nang hindi + verb, 'without doing / lest'): Umalis siya nang hindi nagpapaalam — 'He left without saying goodbye.' Learn this nang hindi construction as a fixed pattern; it is everywhere in narrative prose.

grammar.title: nang vs ng: the rule, finally mastered
grammar.explanation:
The single most common spelling error among native writers — so getting it right marks you as literate. Both are pronounced /nang/. Write ng only for the genitive/object marker: kotse ng guro, kumain ng mansanas. Write nang everywhere else, specifically: (1) 'when' with past events: Nang dumating siya, tulog na ako. (2) Adverbial linker joining verb and manner: Tumakbo siya nang mabilis — 'He ran fast.' (3) Joining repeated verbs: Kain nang kain ang bata — 'The child just kept eating.' (4) So that / with the result that: Mag-aral ka nang makapasa ka. (5) Where the particle na fuses with a following linker -ng before a vowel-adjacent word, the result is also written nang: Malaki na ang gastos → Malaki nang halos doble ang gastos.

Quick tests: Can you replace it with noong ('when')? Write nang. Is it linking a verb to how it was done (adverb)? nang. Is it just marking the object or possessor of a noun/verb? ng. Kumain ako nang mabilis (I ate quickly) vs Kumain ako ng mansanas (I ate an apple) — that minimal pair is the whole rule in miniature.

Bonus: nang also shows up in muntik nang, sabay nang, and after nouns of time: gabi nang dumating kami — 'it was night when we arrived.'

example.tl: Iniimbestigahan pa ang sanhi ng sunog.
example.en: The cause of the fire is still being investigated.

vocab.note: dulot ng = brought about by, due to

example.tl: Nagsara ang mga paaralan dulot ng bagyo.
example.en: Schools closed due to the storm.

vocab.note: bunga ng = as a result of; Bunga nito, ... = As a result, ...

example.tl: Bunga ng pagtitipid nila, nakabili sila ng sariling bahay.
example.en: As a result of their frugality, they were able to buy their own house.

example.tl: Nagtanim sila ng mga puno upang maiwasan ang pagguho ng lupa.
example.en: They planted trees in order to prevent landslides.

example.tl: Umalis siya nang hindi nagpapaalam.
example.en: He left without saying goodbye.

example.tl: Milyon-milyong piso ang pinsalang dulot ng baha.
example.en: The flood caused millions of pesos in damage.

example.tl: Natuyo ang mga palayan dahil sa mahabang tagtuyot.
example.en: The rice fields dried up because of the long drought.

example.tl: Sinira ng mga balang ang kanilang mga pananim.
example.en: Locusts destroyed their crops.

example.tl: Nagbabala sila laban sa posibleng pagguho ng lupa.
example.en: They warned against a possible landslide.

vocab.en: to be able to avoid, prevent

example.tl: Naiwasan ang aksidente dahil maagap ang drayber.
example.en: The accident was avoided because the driver acted promptly.

example.tl: Nagdulot ng matinding trapiko ang saradong kalsada.
example.en: The closed road caused terrible traffic.

example.tl: Nagresulta sa mahabang brownout ang pagsabog ng transformer.
example.en: The transformer explosion resulted in a long power outage.

example.tl: Pinag-aaralan nila ang epekto ng bawal na gamot sa utak.
example.en: They are studying the effect of illegal drugs on the brain.

example.tl: Ito ang kahihinatnan ng pagpapabaya sa kalikasan.
example.en: This is the outcome of neglecting nature.

example.tl: Nagtitipid kami ngayon upang may pang-enrol sa Hunyo.
example.en: We're economizing now so there's money for enrollment in June.

example.tl: Nag-iipon siya para sa paunang bayad ng bahay.
example.en: She is saving up for a house down payment.

example.tl: Ano ang pangunahing layunin ng programa?
example.en: What is the program's main objective?

example.tl: Gumawa ng mga hakbang ang pamahalaan upang pigilan ang epidemya.
example.en: The government took measures to stop the epidemic.

example.tl: Pinigilan ng pulis ang nagpupumilit na pumasok sa gusali.
example.en: The police stopped the person insisting on entering the building.

example.tl: Mabilis na kumalat ang sunog dahil sa hangin.
example.en: The fire spread quickly because of the wind.

example.tl: Hanggang baywang ang baha sa aming kalye kagabi.
example.en: The flood on our street was waist-deep last night.

example.tl: Mabilis na kumalat ang balita sa buong bayan.
example.en: The news spread quickly through the whole town.

example.tl: Walang tigil ang ulan mula pa kagabi.
example.en: The rain has been nonstop since last night.

example.tl: Matindi ang init ngayong tag-araw.
example.en: The heat is intense this summer.

example.tl: Kulang pa kami ng paunang bayad para sa lote.
example.en: We're still short on the down payment for the lot.

example.tl: Pagpapabaya ng kompanya ang sanhi ng aksidente, ayon sa ulat.
example.en: According to the report, the company's negligence was the cause of the accident.

dialogue.title: Pagpupulong pagkatapos ng baha
dialogue.context: A barangay captain and an engineer brief residents after a serious flood, explaining causes and next steps.

lines.speaker: Kapitan
lines.tl: Magandang gabi po sa inyong lahat. Alam kong pagod tayo, kaya dadaan agad ako sa punto: ano ang sanhi ng baha, at ano ang gagawin natin?
lines.en: Good evening, everyone. I know we're tired, so I'll get straight to the point: what caused the flood, and what will we do?

lines.speaker: Inhinyero
lines.tl: Ayon po sa aming pagsusuri, ang baha ay dulot ng dalawang bagay: ang walang tigil na ulan, at ang baradong kanal sa may palengke.
lines.en: According to our assessment, the flood was caused by two things: the nonstop rain, and the blocked canal near the market.

lines.speaker: Residente 1
lines.tl: Bakit po barado ang kanal? Nilinis po iyan noong isang buwan, di ba?
lines.en: Why is the canal blocked? It was cleaned last month, wasn't it?

lines.speaker: Inhinyero
lines.tl: Nilinis nga po, pero bunga ng patuloy na pagtatapon ng basura, mabilis itong napuno ulit.
lines.en: It was cleaned, but as a result of continued dumping of garbage, it quickly filled up again.

lines.speaker: Kapitan
lines.tl: Kaya may dalawang hakbang tayo. Una, lilinisin ang kanal linggo-linggo upang maiwasan ang pagbabara.
lines.en: So we have two measures. First, the canal will be cleaned weekly to prevent blockage.

lines.speaker: Kapitan
lines.tl: Magmumulta po ang sinumang mahuling nagtatapon ng basura sa kanal, upang matigil na ang problema sa ugat nito.
lines.en: Anyone caught dumping garbage in the canal will be fined, so the problem is stopped at its root.

lines.speaker: Residente 1
lines.tl: Mabuti po iyan. Malaki ang pinsalang dulot ng baha sa aming tindahan.
lines.en: That's good. The flood caused a lot of damage to our store.

lines.speaker: Inhinyero
lines.tl: Isa pa po: huwag maghintay ng abiso bago iakyat ang mga gamit. Kapag umulan nang malakas nang mahigit isang oras, kumilos na agad.
lines.en: One more thing: don't wait for a notice before moving belongings up. When it rains hard for more than an hour, act immediately.

lines.speaker: Kapitan
lines.tl: Tandaan po natin: ang pagpapabaya ngayon ang magiging sanhi ng mas malaking pinsala bukas. Magtulungan po tayo.
lines.en: Let's remember: today's neglect will be the cause of greater damage tomorrow. Let's help one another.

reading.title: Ulat: Ang tunay na halaga ng barado nating mga kanal
reading.tl:
Ayon sa pinakahuling ulat ng tanggapan ng pamahalaang panlungsod, umabot sa limampu't walong milyong piso ang kabuuang pinsalang dulot ng mga baha sa lungsod nitong nakaraang taon. Kasama sa bilang na ito ang nasirang mga kalsada, ang pinsala sa mga tindahan at bahay, at ang nawalang kita ng mga negosyong napilitang magsara.

Ano ang sanhi ng problema? Madaling isisi ang lahat sa ulan, ngunit iba ang sinasabi ng datos. Sa dalawampu't isang malubhang pagbaha na naitala, labing-walo ang naganap sa mga lugar na may baradong kanal. Sa madaling salita, hindi lamang kalikasan kundi pagpapabaya ang ugat ng suliranin. Bunga ng taun-taong pagtatapon ng basura sa mga daluyan ng tubig, unti-unting humina ang kakayahan ng lungsod na tanggapin kahit ang karaniwang ulan.

May pag-asa naman. Sa mga barangay na nagpatupad ng linggo-linggong paglilinis at nagmulta sa mga nagtatapon ng basura, bumaba nang halos kalahati ang mga insidente ng pagbaha. Ipinakikita nito na ang maliliit na hakbang, kapag tuloy-tuloy, ay nagdudulot ng malaking pagbabago.

Inirerekomenda ng ulat ang tatlong hakbang: dagdagan ang badyet para sa paglilinis ng mga kanal; palakasin ang kampanya laban sa pagtatapon ng basura; at magtayo ng mas malalaking daluyan sa mga mabababang lugar, upang kahit sa panahon ng matinding ulan ay maiwasan ang malawakang pagbaha. Ang pagpili ay malinaw: gumastos nang kaunti ngayon, o magbayad nang malaki bukas.
reading.en:
According to the latest report of the city government office, the total damage caused by floods in the city this past year reached fifty-eight million pesos. Included in this figure are destroyed roads, damage to shops and houses, and the lost income of businesses forced to close.

What is the cause of the problem? It is easy to blame everything on the rain, but the data says otherwise. Of the twenty-one serious floods recorded, eighteen occurred in areas with blocked canals. In short, the root of the problem is not just nature but neglect. As a result of year-after-year dumping of garbage into the waterways, the city's capacity to absorb even ordinary rain has gradually weakened.

There is hope, however. In the barangays that implemented weekly cleaning and fined garbage dumpers, flooding incidents fell by nearly half. This shows that small measures, when sustained, bring about great change.

The report recommends three steps: increase the budget for canal cleaning; strengthen the campaign against littering; and build larger waterways in low-lying areas, so that even in times of intense rain, widespread flooding can be avoided. The choice is clear: spend a little now, or pay dearly later.

exercises.prompt: Which phrase is the most formal way to say 'as a result of the drought'?
exercises.explain: Bunga ng 'as a result of' is the formal causal phrase. Kasi is casual speech, para sa marks a beneficiary, upang introduces purpose clauses.

exercises.prompt: Choose the correct spelling: Tumakbo siya ___ mabilis papunta sa istasyon.
exercises.explain: Linking a verb to the manner adverb (mabilis) requires nang. Ng is only the genitive/object marker.

exercises.prompt: Kumain ako ___ mansanas bago umalis. (spelling: ng or nang?)
exercises.hint: Is 'mansanas' an object or a manner?
exercises.explain: Mansanas is the object of kumain, so the object marker ng is correct. Nang would be used for manner or 'when'.

exercises.prompt: ___ dumating ang pulis, tumakas na ang magnanakaw. (When — spelling!)
exercises.explain: 'When (past event)' is spelled nang; the noong-substitution test confirms it: Noong dumating ang pulis...

exercises.prompt: Nag-iipon siya ___ makabili ng sariling sasakyan. Which purpose word fits a formal written report?
exercises.explain: Upang is the formal purpose conjunction 'in order to'. Para would be the neutral spoken choice; kasi gives a cause, kaya a result, kapag a condition.

exercises.tl: Nagsara ang mga paaralan sa buong probinsya dulot ng walang tigil na pag-ulan.
choices: Because it was a national holiday
exercises.explain: Dulot ng walang tigil na pag-ulan = 'due to the nonstop rain'. Dulot ng is the news-register cause marker.

exercises.prompt: He left the room without saying goodbye.
exercises.answer: Umalis siya sa kuwarto nang hindi nagpapaalam.
accept: Umalis siya sa kuwarto nang hindi nagpapaalam
Umalis siya sa silid nang hindi nagpapaalam
Nang hindi nagpapaalam, umalis siya sa kuwarto
exercises.explain: Nang hindi + verb is the fixed 'without doing X' construction — and note the nang spelling, since it is not marking an object.

exercises.prompt: Iniimbestigahan pa ng mga awtoridad ang sanhi ng sunog na sumira sa tatlong bahay.
exercises.answer: The authorities are still investigating the cause of the fire that destroyed three houses.
accept: The authorities are still investigating the cause of the fire that destroyed three houses
Authorities are still investigating the cause of the fire which destroyed three houses
The cause of the fire that destroyed three houses is still being investigated by the authorities
exercises.explain: Sanhi ng sunog = 'the cause of the fire'; the relative clause na sumira sa tatlong bahay modifies sunog.

exercises.prompt: Kain ___ kain ang bata mula kanina. Which spelling completes the 'kept on eating' construction?
exercises.explain: Repeated-verb intensives (kain nang kain, takbo nang takbo) always take nang — one of its fixed uses.

exercises.prompt: Gumawa ng mga hakbang ang pamahalaan ___ maiwasan ang malawakang pagbaha. (formal purpose word)
exercises.explain: Upang maiwasan = 'in order to avoid'. Para is also correct but upang matches the formal register of pamahalaan and hakbang.

exercises.tl: Bunga ng pagtitipid nila sa loob ng limang taon, nakapagpundar sila ng maliit na tindahan.
choices: As a result of five years of frugality, they managed to establish a small store.
After five years, their small store went bankrupt.
They borrowed money for five years to buy a store.
Their store's earnings let them stop being frugal five years ago.
exercises.explain: Bunga ng pagtitipid nila = 'as a result of their economizing'; nakapagpundar = 'managed to establish/acquire'. Cause first, happy result second.

exercises.prompt: The rain was intense, and as a result, classes were suspended in order to keep the students safe.
exercises.answer: Matindi ang ulan, at bunga nito, sinuspinde ang mga klase upang mapanatiling ligtas ang mga estudyante.
accept: Matindi ang ulan, at bunga nito, sinuspinde ang mga klase upang mapanatiling ligtas ang mga estudyante
Matindi ang ulan. Bunga nito, sinuspinde ang mga klase upang maging ligtas ang mga estudyante
Matindi ang ulan kaya sinuspinde ang mga klase upang mapanatiling ligtas ang mga mag-aaral
exercises.explain: Bunga nito 'as a result of this' chains cause to effect; upang introduces the purpose. This is the full formal cause-effect-purpose sentence shape of reports.
